mentions.name: Nym
mentions.description: A personal agent that creates and operates all of its own accounts instead of acting as the user, receiving only selective read-only access to the user's accounts. Nyms get their own email addresses at nym-mail.com, can be CC'd on email chains, and can only respond to people on that chain under a 5-day lease (or permanently for people the user specifically adds), with the goal of reliable agents that operate safely in the world without exposing the user's accounts or personal identity.
mentions.problem: Existing personal agents act as you, which risks your reputation, your data and more; their identity model is wrong.
mentions.audience: Individuals who want agents to help them do what they want without exposing their accounts and personal identity to potential harms
mentions.source_excerpt: Nym is a personal agent that has (and can make) all of its own accounts and only gets selective read only access to yours.
